text:
Nina (CS): Hi team — kicking off Synapse onboarding. Goal: have first PROD-ready integration and 2 pilot flows running in 15 days. Who from Synapse will own success?
Marco (CS): Hi! I'll lead the day-to-day CS work and own weekly check-ins. Need a list of Synapse stakeholders + their roles.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll handle the technical intake (API keys, dataset mapping). Can we get SSO details and sample payloads?
Owen (AE): Synapse will share: Emma (CTO), Raj (SRE), and Lea (Product). I'll loop them in after we confirm dates.
Nina (CS): Success criteria proposal: 1) auth + sample inference call succeeding in staging, 2) two end-to-end flows with <1s median latency in staging load test, 3) basic monitoring hooks + alerting in Console. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Priya (Solutions Eng): Agree. For monitoring: we want token-level cost visibility + per-route latency traces. I'll prepare a short instr doc.
Sam (Onboarding PM): Timeline draft:
```
Day 0-2: Tech intake (keys, SSO, sample data)
Day 3-6: Staging integration + smoke tests
Day 7-10: Pilot flows + load test
Day 11-13: Fixes + SLA configs
Day 14-15: Prod cutover readiness + go/no-go
```
Sam (Onboarding PM): Proposed syncs: Mon/Wed 30m checkpoints, Friday retro.
Marco (CS): Risks: (a) data mapping delays, (b) SSO cert rotation lag, (c) Synapse infra windows overlapping our load tests. We should ask Raj for maintenance windows.
Owen (AE): Noted. I'll confirm maintenance windows and EMMA/LEA availability.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Two quick asks: 1) share a sample inference payload (anonymized) 2) open a Jira with "synapse-onboard" tag for prioritization.
Nina (CS): I'll create the Jira and add the checklist. Also scheduling an enablement session for Synapse product and engineering on Day 4 — preferred 30-45m.
Owen (AE): Synapse prefers afternoons PST. I'll propose Thu 14:00 PST.
Sam (Onboarding PM): Calendar: https://cal.example.com/synapse-onboard-provision — I'll post invites once Owen confirms stakeholder times.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet for staging creds (put in secret manager):
```
REDFLOW_STAGING_API_KEY=redacted
REDFLOW_REGION=us-west-2
```
Priya (Solutions Eng): We'll validate keys on Day 3.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for staging gateway tests on Day 5 — reminder will post 24h prior.
Marco (CS): Perfect. Nina/Sam — can you capture renewal-risk flags? Synapse has a trial commitment and is sensitive to latency/cost. If pilot shows >2x expected cost, renewal conversation could be impacted.
Nina (CS): Copied — adding renewal-risk tracker in the Jira (fields: baseline cost per 1000 tokens, target latency SLA, escalation owner).
Owen (AE): I'll share Synapse's procurement timeline — they have an internal review at Day 30. This onboarding window is critical.
Priya (Solutions Eng): One more item: do we want to enable prefix caching for the pilot? That will reduce token costs but affects dev iteration. Recommend enabling only for load tests.
Marco (CS): Agreed — enable for load runs only.
Sam (Onboarding PM): Actions: 1) Owen to confirm stakeholder availability (by EOD), 2) Synapse to provide sample payload + SSO metadata (by Day 2), 3) Nina to create Jira + checklist (by EOD), 4) Priya to draft monitoring/integration guide (Day 2), 5) Sam to post calendar invites (after stakeholder confirm).
Nina (CS): Thanks all — tagging follow-ups here tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
Owen (AE): Confirmed I'll loop Emma/Raj/Lea and propose Thu 14:00 PST.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ready to start intake as soon as payloads arrive.
Marco (CS): We'll plan the Day 1 kickoff call once calendar is set.
Nina (CS): End of thread for now — will update Jira and ping once done.
